summary: Connect results chains, indicators and evidence to programme decisions. Explore practical RBME training and strengthen your monitoring approach.
lede: Results-based monitoring and evaluation (RBME) tracks progress against intended outcomes and uses evidence to guide programme decisions. Designed for monitoring and evaluation officers, programme managers and results analysts, the course covers mapping results chains, selecting indicators, checking data quality and interpreting variance to produce concise reports and management responses.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, run or review programme monitoring and evaluation and need to connect reported outputs with verifiable outcome evidence.
prerequisites: Familiarity with programme or project objectives and routine reporting is useful. No coding is required for the described exercises.
